payload.reason: The evidence specifies that the significance test was performed using data from the CoNLL-2014 shared task, which included evaluations of automatic and gold references with the M2 scorer and bootstrap significance testing.

claims.text: The significance test was performed using data from the CoNLL-2014 shared task.
Bootstrap significance testing was used to compare automatic and gold references.
The evaluation involved 1,000 iterations of significance testing with a p-value threshold of 0.05.
